name: Designer — text prompt generates a room layout

planSteps.description: In the chat input, enter: "Design a 520 x 430 cm minimalist bedroom with a queen bed, two nightstands, wardrobe, desk near the window, rug, and plant. Keep an 80 cm walkway."
Submit the chat message and wait for the agent response to finish.
The right canvas no longer shows the empty-state title "No layout yet".
The rendered floor-plan surface shows room dimensions including "520" and "430".
The rendered layout includes bedroom furniture labels or text for bed, wardrobe, desk, and rug.
